title: Demo notification arm bypasses notification_target_path — routing decision duplicated inline (round-2 hard blocker class)
detail: The round-2 contract requires BOTH arms route through the pure notification_target_path/3 (client.gleam:6929). The real arm does (client.gleam:4399) but the demo arm re-implements only the application branch inline, so the two routing decisions can silently drift.
recommended_fix: Have demo_update's UserClickedNotification call client.notification_target_path(model, entity_type, entity_id) (resolve_application_vacancy already short-circuits to the demo store when demo_mode is True) instead of the inline case.

title: Claimed client test-count delta (+5, 632→637) does not match the diff, which adds 16 tests and removes none
evidence: grep -c '^+pub fn .*_test() {' diff.patch => 16; grep -c '^-pub fn .*_test() {' diff.patch => 0. Worktree total: grep -rc '_test() {' client/test --include='*.gleam' sums to 637.
detail: The tree holds 637 test functions matching the claim, but 632 + 16 added = 648. Eleven tests are unaccounted for — either the round-1 baseline of 632 was misreported or tests were dropped outside this diff. The '637 green' claim cannot be reconciled with the r1 baseline.
recommended_fix: Reconcile the baseline: confirm what the client suite counted at the r1 sha and whether any tests were removed between rounds; re-run `make test-client` and report the actual pass count.
